constraints.condition: per project

evidence.quoted_text: All approvals must be recorded in the finance system within two business days. The Financial Controller will sample approvals quarterly and report exceptions to the Audit and Risk Committee. Capital expenditure approved by the Finance Director is capped at AUD 100,000 per project and must be reported to the Committee at its next meeting. This policy will be reviewed annually or earlier if the Company's structure changes materially.

constraints.condition: request to vary a limit must be made in writing

evidence.quoted_text: Questions about this policy should be directed to the Office of the CFO. Requests to vary a limit must be made in writing and approved by the Board. The Company's general travel policy, gifts and hospitality policy and procurement policy continue to apply alongside this document. Employees are reminded that the Company's values of integrity, accountability and respect apply to every financial decision.
